# Picsart

> This file is here to help AI tools - and curious users - find the most helpful, official pages on our site.

Picsart is a leading creative design platform powered by AI, empowering millions of people to design, edit, create, and generate content with the latest AI models, tools, and workflows. From social posts to professional ads, we make creation fast, fun, and intuitive for everyone (creators, marketers, businesses, and individuals).

## Start Here
- [Picsart Homepage](https://picsart.com): Discover our tools, templates, and AI-powered creative experiences in one place.

## For People Who Design with Picsart
- [Templates](https://picsart.com/templates/): Ready-made designs for everything from social media to business.
- [Design Tools](https://picsart.com/design-tools/): Tools to customize graphics, layouts, and text.
- [Image Tools](https://picsart.com/image-tools/): Resize, crop, and edit photos with precision.
- [AI Tools](https://picsart.com/ai-tools/): Explore generative AI features like text-to-image and background replacement.
- [Video Tools](https://picsart.com/video-tools/): Edit and animate short-form videos with ease.

## Main Products
- [Photo Editor](https://picsart.com/photo-editor/): A powerful, browser-based photo editor.
- [AI Photo Editor](https://picsart.com/ai-photo-editor/): Use artificial intelligence to transform images in one click.

## Resources
- [Blog](https://picsart.com/blog/): Tips, inspiration, and tutorials to level up your creativity.
- [Support Center](https://support.picsart.com): Answers to common questions and help topics.
